_about: Problem 2 data fixes: 3 catalogue rows in the original data pack are filename-based stubs (no colors, 'Vision blocked' description). The owner reviewed the product photos and supplied these values. db.ensure_schema() applies them on startup, only while a row is still the original stub.

catalogue.description: Heather gray short-sleeve T-shirt with a large red, white, and blue Benjamin Franklin College shield crest centered on the chest above black "BENJAMIN FRANKLIN COLLEGE" lettering.

Heather gray full-zip sweater fleece jacket with a stand collar, charcoal zipper and pocket trim, zippered hand pockets, and an embroidered red Berkeley College shield crest with "BERKELEY" text on the left chest.
Heather gray crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband, featuring a red Timothy Dwight College shield crest with a lion and "TIMOTHY DWIGHT" text on the left chest.
